children: Myers Industries entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to sell all membership interests of Myers Tire Supply and related subsidiaries to TAPS Holdings for $30 million, subject to customary adjustments. The divestiture removes the company’s North American tire supply distribution division from its portfolio. Myers Industries agreed to a 36-month non-compete with specified carve-outs, while the buyer obtained representation and warranty insurance. The transaction is intended to streamline the company’s operations and focus on core businesses.
